elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance to Customer.
elements.evidence: Section 14a applies “[u]pon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason” and requires TrueLink, at Client’s request, to “provide reasonable transition assistance.” The request condition appropriately makes the assistance available when Client requires it.

elements.element: Transition assistance is available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) expressly provides transition assistance “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance is provided at Vendor’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) expressly states that assistance will be provided “at TrueLink’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data to Customer upon expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires TrueLink to “return to Client all Client Content, Client Proprietary Information and other data of Client in TrueLink’s possession or control.”

elements.element: Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires the return “within thirty (30) days of such expiration or termination.”

elements.element: Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) expressly requires return “in a standard machine-readable format.”

elements.element: Vendor deletes Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(c) requires TrueLink to “thereafter delete” the returned categories of Client data from its systems.

elements.element: Vendor certifies the deletion of Customer Data after its return.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(c) requires TrueLink to “certify such deletion to Client in writing” after the return and deletion duties.

elements.element: Upon expiry or termination, Vendor provides transition assistance for 90 days.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(a) makes transition assistance available at Client’s request for up to six months, which encompasses the fallback 90-day period.

elements.element: Vendor exports Customer Data to Customer within 30 days after expiry or termination.
elements.evidence: Section 14a(b) requires TrueLink to return all specified Client data to Client in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days after expiration or termination.

result.reason: The added operative provision fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It addresses both expiration and termination, provides up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, requires machine-readable data return within 30 days, and requires subsequent deletion and written certification. The amendment is confined to transition and data-return obligations and does not disturb unrelated termination terms.
